full_prompt_en: A square cut-paper animation scene shows a small golden figure walking across rolling yellow hills beneath a turquoise sky. The background is a single deep teal field with a faint fibrous surface, so the bright yellow sun near the upper right reads as a separate circular piece set over it. A small group of blue-green cloud shapes sits just below the sun, their scalloped edges casting a narrow dark shadow to the right. On the left, a tall tree rises from the slope, with a dark brown trunk and rounded, ochre foliage assembled from visibly distinct layers. A second tree stands farther back, its crown partly hidden behind the first. The small walking figure is near the left-center ridge, upright and sharply silhouetted in bright yellow against a darker green hollow. Below, wide bands of ochre, mustard, and warm gold curve from one side of the frame to the other, overlapping like individually cut sheets. Their raised edges leave thin shaded seams, while the slopes alternate between smooth open areas and clusters of small leafy shapes. Near the lower middle, a broad foreground hill has a soft granular face; at the right edge, another irregular clump of foliage interrupts the clean arc of the horizon. The tree branches and bushes have simplified, handmade contours rather than fine botanical detail. Strong light appears to come from the upper right, making the sun and upper surfaces glow while the stacked paper forms cast short, directional shadows toward the lower left. The contrast between matte paper color and the dark recesses gives the scene a shallow theatrical depth without making it look like an open landscape photograph. The overall composition uses sweeping golden curves, tiny upright accents, and a still turquoise field to create a warm, playful sense of travel.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形剪纸动画风景中，一个小小的金色身影在青绿色天空下穿过起伏的黄色山丘。背景是一整片深青绿色色域，带有轻微的纤维表面感，因此右上方明亮的黄色太阳像另外放上去的一块圆形纸片。太阳下方有一小组蓝绿色云形，扇贝状边缘向右投出一道窄而深的影子。左侧一棵高树从坡地上升起，深棕色树干和圆润的赭黄树冠由清楚分开的层片组成。更后面还有一棵树，树冠部分被前树遮住。行走的小身影位于左中部的山脊附近，直立而轮廓鲜明，亮黄色与身后的深绿色洼地形成对照。下方宽阔的赭色、芥末黄和暖金色带状山丘从画面一侧弯向另一侧，像逐片裁出的纸张互相覆盖。抬起的边缘留下细窄的阴影接缝，坡面则在平滑开阔的区域和成簇的小叶形之间交替。靠近下方中央，一道宽阔的前景山丘带有柔和的颗粒表面；右边缘另有一团不规则叶丛，打断了地平线整洁的弧线。树枝与灌木采用简化的手作轮廓，没有细密的植物学刻画。强光似乎来自右上方，使太阳和上层表面发亮，而叠起的纸形向左下投出短而定向的影子。哑光纸色与深色凹隙之间的反差赋予场景浅浅的舞台纵深，却不让它看起来像开阔风景照片。整体构图以扫过画面的金色曲线、小小的直立点缀和静止的青绿色色域，形成温暖俏皮的行旅感。
style_prompt_en: The image has the tactile finish of layered cut paper, with broad matte color fields separated by narrow shadows at their raised edges. Rounded silhouettes and scalloped contours reduce forms to clear graphic masses, while small irregular cuts keep the geometry handmade. Golden yellow and ochre occupy the largest area against a deep blue-green field; limited dark brown accents anchor the light colors. Directional illumination gives each overlapping layer a slight relief, so depth is read through seams and cast shadows rather than detailed perspective. Fine grain and faint fibrous texture temper the saturated palette. The composition alternates long flowing bands with compact upright marks and open negative space, creating a playful, stage-like rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现层叠剪纸的可触质感，宽阔的哑光色域由抬起边缘处的窄阴影分隔。圆润的剪影和扇贝状轮廓把形体简化为清楚的图形色块，细小的不规则裁切则保留手作几何感。金黄与赭色占据最大面积，与深蓝绿色色域相对，少量深棕色点缀稳住浅色。定向照明使每层交叠处略显凸起，纵深主要通过接缝和投影而非细致透视来辨读。细颗粒和隐约的纤维肌理缓和了饱和配色。构图让长而流动的色带与紧凑的直立笔形、开阔留白交替，形成俏皮而有舞台感的节奏。
theme_en: A lone small figure crossing a layered golden cut-paper landscape
theme_zh: 一个小小的独行身影穿过层叠的金色剪纸风景
name: Cutout animation
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
